essential_tweet_embeddings.annotation: Semantic leap: Yatharth frames the house fundraiser as 'noticing what is happening'—reframing crowdfunding as community infrastructure rather than charity
essential_tweet_embeddings.tweet_text:
fyi this feels worth reading. even if you don't contribute, just noticing what is happening https://t.co/raG72YCTpg https://t.co/jY21m0arEC

Images:
- [Image #0] The image contains a tweet thread by Jess (not a saint) (@frideswyth) on November 26. The text is presented in white against a dark blue background.

The first tweet reads: "But all this is only possible if I have the *whole amount* up front to buy the house. Mortgages are a scheme of control that lock you in to paying back at least 140% of the principle on a 10 year mortgage. The second you sign one, you're trapped. Please. It makes sense."

The second tweet states: "Oh & after I have paid you back, I will be sharing my house with people *rent free* because I believe in the power of free things. Whatever earnings I have, you will be sure that I use them to *help other people outright buy property* and continue the chain of free housing for all."

The image includes various engagement metrics, such as likes, retweets, and replies, indicating a significant level of interaction with the content.
